learned_rules:
- **The money shape rates 8, or 9 if the radar shows the story still climbing and mcap is under ~$1M.** The shape: a MIGRATED coin leading on 5m volume, 25–45% off its local high, with a higher low printed above the hourly low, 5m flow at or above the hourly pace, more buys than sells, top 10 under 15% and low RugCheck bundles. Both real winners looked like this (CATBOT 4.44x, FLOATER 2.19x), and CPU and FLOAT peaked at 1.6x+ from it (V1, V6, V13).
- **The owner's floor is 7.** If the hard lines pass, flow is live (5m at least $10k and at or above pace) and the first resistance is at least 1.5x away, the rating is 7 or higher. Don't take points off for things the checklist already measured.
- **The MIGRATED buy zone is 10–60% off the local high** (owner rule). Within 10% of the high is a PASS, blocker "chasing". Of 54 skips there, 4 ran and 42 dumped.
- **The shallow band (10–25% off the high) is a breakout trade, capped at 7.** The coin has to be the 5m volume leader, pushing into the high right now, with flow at or above pace. Otherwise PASS, blocker "no breakout".
- **A spike counts as chasing anywhere in the zone.** If the last 5m candle is up more than 25%, or 5m volume is over 3x the hourly pace, wait for a retrace and a printed higher low. Blocker "chasing spike" (PILLSEY, −31%).
- **On MIGRATED, flow below pace is a PASS, never a probe.** Blocker "flow below pace" (HYPERCHAN, BLUE and AAPLCAT never went green; of 7 skips, 0 ran and 5 dumped).
- **Rate on the first resistance (prior high, POC or 0.618).** 1.5x or more away can rate 8–9. At 1.3–1.5x the cap is 7. Under 1.3x is a PASS, blocker "target too close".
- **Entries above ~$1M mcap are capped at 7 and need the first resistance at least 1.5x away right now.** My 10 entries above $1M went 0 for 10 (one +0.7% scratch), and only FLOAT got past 1.5x. Big caps don't double inside a time stop. Blocker "target too close".
- **A migration under 1h old that is still bleeding off its bond spike waits for a base above the hourly low.** Blocker "too new". Of 39 skips, 4 ran and 35 dumped; SI lost 38%.
- **In a vamp field, buy only the leader by 5m volume and radar mentions.** A bundle cluster inside a big same-ticker field is a PASS, blocker "split crowd" (BLUE, V1, V3).
- **A DIP needs 40–70% drawdown, 5m flow at least 0.7x the hourly pace, the story still on the radar, and a printed higher low.** The higher low means a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, then a reclaim of the pullback high. A buy share is not a higher low, and neither is the first red-to-green candle. If flow is at or above pace, size by conviction (7+). At 0.7–1.0x pace it's a 6 probe at most. A thin tech or LARP story is a PASS, blocker "dead story". An already-printed catalyst stays a probe until the reclaim. DIPs are 0 for 5.
- **Hard blocks:** top 10 over 25%, dev over 1%, bundles or insiders over the line, mint or freeze authority live, LP not burned, a political figure, RugCheck danger or RugCheck not loading, any hack/exploit/drain story (V6, V13, V17, owner). Every one of these skip groups dumped far more often than it ran.
- **Never-green cut:** in the first 10 minutes, if the coin is under 0.92x, or hasn't reached 1.05x by minute 10, and 5m flow is under pace, sell at market. The 6 never-green stop-outs closed between −30% and −38% against a −20% stop.
- **Protect green trades before initials.** If a trade is green and 5m volume drops under half the hourly pace, sell half. At the time stop, exit unless a volume surge is printing right now. No extensions past the time stop: FLOAT (158 min, −24.5%) and Leverhedge (76 min, −3.2%) both lost on extra time.
- **Stops sell with no review** (8 of 8 reviews closed worse than the stop). Re-enter a stopped-out coin only when it reclaims its prior high with flow at or above pace, and at most once per coin: re-entries are 0 for 4 (CATBOT −24%, HEXN −27%, ANAKIN −20%, HYPERCHAN −5%).

rule_changes.rule: DIP gate now sizes by conviction when higher low and pace are confirmed (owner override)
rule_changes.evidence: Owner (Oct 30): DIP probation is over, gate at 0.7x pace with no 'rising' needed. I kept the higher-low requirement because 0 for 5 says entry timing is the problem, and only flow below pace is capped at a 6 probe. Also enforced 0.7x in code via dip_min_attention_ratio.

rule_changes.rule: Never-green cut: also sell at market if under 0.92x inside the first 10 minutes with flow under pace
rule_changes.evidence: Five trades peaked at 1.01x or lower and closed −30% to −38% against a −20% stop (SI, HEXN, BLUE, SIS, AAPLCAT). SI and HEXN fell through the stop within 7 minutes, before the old 10-minute check could fire.

rule_changes.rule: Any fee, friction or minimum-size wording
rule_changes.evidence: Fees and size are checked in code (target must pay 3x the round trip, round trip at most 20% of size). The current rules already carried none, and none were added back.

rule_changes.rule: Entries above ~$1M mcap capped at 7 and need the first resistance at least 1.5x away
rule_changes.evidence: 10 entries above ~$1M (CATBOT buy-back, FLOAT, HYPERCHAN x2, Leverhedge, PAWCAT, AAPLCAT, ANAKIN x2, Something): 0 wins, one +0.7% scratch, about −15% average. Only FLOAT got past 1.5x.

rule_changes.rule: DIP gate merged with the higher-low rule; flow at least 0.7x pace
rule_changes.evidence: DIPs are 0 for 5 (−$6.70). Falling-knife (code) skips: 23 of 29 dumped. No-higher-low skips: 12 of 16 dumped. This now matches the owner's 0.7x gate and the parameter.

rule_changes.rule: Time stop: dropped the 90-minute extension for >$1M coins
rule_changes.evidence: Holding past the time stop lost both times: FLOAT at 158 min, −24.5%, and Leverhedge at 76 min, −3.2%. No time-stopped trade later became a winner.

rule_changes.rule: Stops sell with no review; re-entry at most once per coin, only on a prior-high reclaim
rule_changes.evidence: 8 of 8 stop reviews closed worse than the stop. Re-entries are 0 for 4.
Merged into the DIP higher-low rule to stay at 15 bullets; nothing was lost.
